The '''concussion grenade''', sometimes referred to as '''concussion bomb''', was a common grenade in widespread use since before the formation of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and evolved little over thousands of years. There were three main designs of concussion grenades.

==Variations==
[[File:Concussion_Grenade.jpg|thumb|left|A typical concussion grenade.]]
One kind was designed for use against vehicles and equipment. The grenade was very useful against vehicles that were fast or slow moving because of its tendency to stick to a vehicle's armor. The grenade was not used much against organics, due to its small blast radius.<ref name="Battlefront">''[[Star Wars: Battlefront]]''</ref>

==History==
The grenades were used during the [[Invasion of Naboo/Legends|Invasion of Naboo]].<ref name="SW:OW">[[Star Wars: Obi-Wan (video game)|''Star Wars: Obi-Wan'']]</ref>

In [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]], [[Boba Fett/Legends|Boba Fett]] used concussion grenades to blast his way out of the [[Sarlacc/Legends|Sarlacc]] on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]].
